title: a16z Podcast: Self-Driving Cars — Where Are We, Really?

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: As cars become more like iPhones and less like just, well, cars — everything changes.
reader_summary.overview: As cars become more like iPhones and less like just, well, cars — everything changes, from data to mapping to interfaces to security and more. Where are we anyway, given all the hype around when self-driving cars will appear everywhere? And where are new opportunities in the space?

key_points.text: This episode of the a16z Podcast, based on a panel discussion from the most recent a16z Summit.
Guests include: Taggart Matthiesen, head of product at Lyft, which is developing autonomous car technology; James Wu, CEO and co-founder of DeepMap.
––– The views expressed here are those of the individual AH Capital Management, L.L.C.
